title: Our Place
description: Jacob Willett's first project — pitched and developed by him before he brought in writers Amanda Harper and Wren Jordan, then directed, in his first semester of SDSU's film program. Winner, Best Original Song at the San Diego Short Film Festival's Q3 showcase: a devious romance emerges in the midst of a tragic breakup, starring Jordan Davenport, Angel Huerta, and Lucien Escarguel. A queer anti-romance inspired by John Waters and Divine's "Female Trouble," scored with a fully custom-composed piece for live brass, organ, piano, and clarinet — the lead actress came into the studio to record vocals over it.
